selectionNotes: Fresh non-duplicate U.S. independent/local service-business prospects selected with public lightweight browsing only. No outreach performed.

items.name: A&D Exteriors
items.vertical: roofing, siding, windows, gutters, and home exterior remodeling
items.summary: Family-owned exterior contractor with strong project proof and warranty language; the quote path can be made more direct before visitors hit project/blog/form density.
items.angle: Local, licensed exterior proof is strong, but the homepage pushes visitors through many services, projects, blogs, and footer links before the quote request feels like the obvious next step.

items.name: SpeedKleen Carpet Cleaners
items.vertical: eco-friendly carpet, rug, floor, and upholstery cleaning
items.summary: Eco-friendly carpet cleaner with a clear green promise; scattered service lists, raw links, login clutter, and long pricing notes weaken the quick-quote path.
items.angle: The green, family-safe positioning is strong, but the homepage feels like a long list of services and fine print instead of a fast quote/appointment flow.

items.name: D.O.A. Pest Control
items.summary: Family-owned pest control company with 31+ years of proof; duplicated service blocks and placeholder-style links dilute the otherwise strong same-day guarantee story.
items.angle: D.O.A. has a strong local pest-control story, but repeated Commercial/Residential blocks and duplicated pest sections make urgent visitors work harder than necessary.

items.name: Men In Black Pest Control
items.vertical: residential and commercial pest control and exclusion services
items.summary: Strong brand, rating, and process already exist; repeated menu/CTA sections and a long SEO block can be tightened around estimate requests.
items.angle: Men In Black already has a memorable brand and 4.9 rating, but duplicate navigation/CTA text and long local SEO copy create scroll friction after a strong first impression.

items.name: Stec Roofing S&G, Inc.
items.vertical: residential, commercial, industrial, and institutional roofing
items.summary: Long-running Naperville roofer with strong trust proof; inconsistent years and one visibly incorrect service link make this a high-value trust polish opportunity.
items.angle: A 1966 family-owned roofing company has excellent credibility, but inconsistent experience claims and a wrong service link undercut trust before the free-estimate CTA.

items.name: Everlast Exteriors of Illinois Inc
items.vertical: windows, siding, roofing, and storm-damage exterior contractor
items.summary: Established exterior contractor with 39+ years, warranty, and premium brands; duplicated nav/serving text and form-heavy opening dilute the estimate request.
items.angle: Everlast has great proof — 39+ years, same-day consultations, free inspections, lifetime warranty — but repeated menu/serving lines make the top of the homepage feel less controlled.

items.name: Koshgarian Rug Cleaners
items.vertical: rug, carpet, upholstery, floor, and water-damage cleaning
items.summary: Century-old family rug cleaner with two local locations; duplicate service grids and many utility links can be reduced around request-service and pickup/drop-off paths.
items.angle: The 100+ year family story and new Naperville location are excellent, but service cards repeat and important pickup/drop-off/request-service choices compete with a large nav.

items.name: Russell Martin Carpet & Rugs
items.vertical: carpet, rugs, installation, cleaning, and flooring services
items.summary: Trusted Naperville carpet and rug brand with decades of proof; mismatched service links, typo-level polish issues, and long testimonial flow can be tightened.
items.angle: Russell Martin has strong local trust and testimonials, but a few service-card link mismatches and dense storytelling distract from the free estimate path.

items.name: Executive Green Carpet Cleaning Services
items.vertical: carpet, upholstery, rug, tile, hardwood, and commercial cleaning
items.summary: Green cleaning company with strong reviews and 24/7 scheduling; duplicated menu text and malformed phone-link output suggest a quick trust and CTA polish win.
items.angle: Executive Green already has strong service proof and reviews, but duplicate menu text and awkward phone-link output make the top of the page feel less polished than the work described.

items.name: Perfect Exteriors
items.vertical: roofing, siding, gutters, windows, doors, skylights, and exterior repair
items.summary: Family-owned exterior contractor with BBB/licensed proof; cramped copy, missing spacing, and an oversized service list can be reframed around inspection booking.
items.angle: Perfect Exteriors has valuable proof and a wide service offering, but copy spacing issues and a long service catalog make the Book Inspection path harder to feel confident about.
